metadata.question: Does the ice cover extent on Lake Erie decrease in January 14, 2014 compared to January 9, 2014?

data.raw_code: The question asks: "Does the ice cover extent on Lake Erie decrease in January 14, 2014 compared to January 9, 2014?" We need to: 1. Search strategy: Use MODIS snow/ice cover product (MOD10A1) which has daily 500m resolution data. This provides NDSI (Normalized Difference Snow Index) which is good for detecting ice/snow. 2. Masking strategy: The MOD10A1 has quality bands. We'll use the QA band to mask poor quality pixels. 3. Logic: Compare ice extent between two specific dates. Need to check if data exists for both dates, calculate ice area, and compare. Approach: 1. Define Lake Erie geometry (simplified polygon) 2. For each date, get MOD10A1 image 3. Check collection size - if 0 for either date, output C1 4. Use NDSI band with threshold > 0.4 to identify ice 5. Apply quality mask using QA band 6. Calculate ice area in square km 7. Compare areas - if Jan 14 < Jan 9, answer A (Yes), else B (No) 8. Check for valid pixels after masking (C2) and valid calculations (C3) Data notes: - MOD10A1: MODIS/Terra Snow Cover Daily L3 Global 500m - Band: NDSI_Snow_Cover (0-100% snow cover) - We'll use NDSI band and threshold at 0.4 for ice detection - QA band: bits 0-1 indicate quality (0=best, 1=good, 2=ok, 3=poor) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Simplified Lake Erie polygon var lakeErie = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-83.0, 41.5], [-82.0, 41.5], [-82.0, 42.5], [-83.0, 42.5], [-83.0, 41.5]] ]); // Date ranges (single day each) var date1 = '2014-01-09'; var date2 = '2014-01-14'; // Function to get ice area for a specific date function getIceArea(date) { var collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1') .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(lakeErie); var size = collection.size().getInfo(); print(date + ' Images:', size); if (size === 0) { return {area: null, validPixels: 0, hasData: false}; } var image = collection.first(); // Get NDSI band (Normalized Difference Snow Index) var ndsi = image.select('NDSI').multiply(0.0001); // Scale factor // Quality mask - use QA band bits 0-1 (0=best, 1=good) var qa = image.select('QA'); var qualityMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).lt(2); // Keep best and good quality // Apply quality mask and threshold for ice (NDSI > 0.4) var iceMask = ndsi.updateMask(qualityMask).gt(0.4); // Count valid pixels var pixelCount = iceMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: lakeErie, scale: 500, // MODIS resolution maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI').getInfo(); // Calculate area in square km var area = iceMask.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).divide(1000000); // m² to km² var areaValue = area.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeErie, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI').getInfo(); return { area: areaValue, validPixels: pixelCount || 0, hasData: true }; } // 2. Data Acquisition & Check var result1 = getIceArea(date1); var result2 = getIceArea(date2); // Check for empty collections if (!result1.hasData || !result2.hasData) { print("One or both dates have no data."); print("C1"); return; } // Check for no valid pixels if (result1.validPixels === 0 || result2.validPixels === 0) { print("No valid ice pixels detected."); print("Jan 9 valid pixels:", result1.validPixels); print("Jan 14 valid pixels:", result2.validPixels); print("C2"); return; } // 3. Calculation & Validation print("Jan 9 Ice Area (km²):", result1.area); print("Jan 14 Ice Area (km²):", result2.area); print("Jan 9 Valid Pixels:", result1.validPixels); print("Jan 14 Valid Pixels:", result2.validPixels); // Check for calculation failure if (result1.area === null || result2.area === null || isNaN(result1.area) || isNaN(result2.area)) { print("Calculation failed - null or NaN result."); print("C3"); return; } // Check for unrealistic values (NDSI range is -1 to 1, area should be reasonable) if (result1.area < 0 || result2.area < 0 || result1.area > 100000 || result2.area > 100000) { // Lake Erie area ~25,700 km² print("Unrealistic ice area detected."); print("C3"); return; } // 4. Final Answer var decrease = result2.area < result1.area; if (decrease) { print("Ice extent decreased from Jan 9 to Jan 14."); print("A"); } else { print("Ice extent did not decrease from Jan 9 to Jan 14."); print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
